description: Start or resume an existing outbound call campaign so Kai begins calling its leads. Needs campaign_id and agent_id (an agent assigned to the same business), the calls:write scope and an admin role in the business. Queues the campaign's pending calls within its call windows; real people get phone calls once it runs. A queued result does not mean any call was answered or completed. pause_call_campaign stops it. Not for email campaigns.

agent_id.description: The agent that places the calls. Must belong to the same business.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the token can reach more than one business.

name: launch_call_campaign
title: Launch Call Campaign
